metadata.title: Addresses in Schleswig
metadata.description: Official ALKIS house coordinates for Schleswig, transformed to WGS 84.

source.publisher: Landesamt für Vermessung und Geoinformation Schleswig-Holstein

steps: Filtered by official state 01, district 59 and municipality 075; verified administrative region 0 and AGS 01059075.
Selected address fields, preserving original OIDs, street names, string identifiers and source record order.
Converted empty address extras and postal codes to null.
Transformed EPSG:25832 easting/northing to EPSG:4326 latitude/longitude with pyproj 3.7.2 and PROJ 9.5.1, without decimal rounding.
Verified field preservation, municipality membership, unique IDs, coordinate ranges, reference points and inverse coordinate transformations.
